item.title: Incarico post-doc: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna - one annual post doc position in Management (Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-18 12:00
Institution: Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA, Pisa
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

Research activity in the frame of the European COMMONS project. Specifically, it is required to contribute to research activities concerning: a) the definition and evaluation of prevention, diagnostic, and therapeutic pathways relating to non-communicable diseases; b) the contextualization of such pathways within the healthcare settings of developing countries; c) the design of strategies for engaging various stakeholders and defining both operational and policy recommendations for the implementation of the proposed pathways. Support and mentoring in teaching and seminar activities at both the Scuola and partner institutions are also required.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Computational Methodologies for the Analysis of Disinformation and Digital Information Ecosystems (LUISS G.Carli ROMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-16 23:59
Institution: LUISS G.Carli ROMA, Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The project investigates the evolution of digital information ecosystems, the spread of disinformation, and information manipulation affecting public debate and democratic processes. Combining computational methods and qualitative research, it uses data from online platforms, open sources, and the Italian Digital Media Observatory (IDMO). Machine learning, NLP, network analysis, and AI will be used to detect emerging narratives, coordinated campaigns, information anomalies, and diffusion patterns. Particular attention will be paid to disinformation, influence operations, AI-generated synthetic content, and FIMI, including during elections and crises. The project will produce evidence,…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Business model transformation in the hospitality and tourism sector (IULM - MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 23:59
Institution: IULM - MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-06 Economia aziendale

Digital technology and sustainability are transforming tourism. Responding to these drivers of change requires the synergistic involvement of DMOs, hospitality and catering businesses, which are harnessing digital technologies – and AI in particular – to drive innovation. The research project analyses the evolution of business models in tourism, examining business processes of experience design and the co-creation of experiences with consumers. The aim is to generate greater insight into the nature of the change currently taking place, understanding how it can deliver benefits for businesses, consumers and destinations. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Evolution of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes and packaging producers’ obligations across EU Member States following Regulation (EU) 2025/40: comparative analysis, producer fees and recovery and recycling performance. (Univ. TUSCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. TUSCIA, Viterbo
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-10 Scienze merceologiche

The position is part of a European-scale research project co-funded by CONAI under the Implementing Agreement of 10/09/2026, aimed at updating CONAI’s “Packaging for Europe – P4EU” portal and at producing information notes for companies. The entry into force of Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR) requires Member States to adapt their packaging management models – EPR schemes and the related Producer Responsibility Organisations (PROs), deposit return systems (DRS) and tax systems – with direct implications for the obligations and fees borne by producers.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: The analysis and evaluation of the cultural politics in Italy (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-03 Demografia e statistica sociale

The research aims to develop composite economic and social indicators for evaluating a series of cultural policy measures within the Italian context. It intends to carry out a quantitative analysis of the efficiency and effectiveness of public spending measures in the field of culture. For the purposes of this research, the most relevant demographic, economic, and social dimensions identified by the sector's literature will be taken into consideration.
